messages:
jess: Quick Q — where should I look for per-pool saturation signals for eu-dedicated-1? trying to tune alarms before EOD. Looking for autoscale graphs + traces. @mike

mike: Start with the pool dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/pools/eu-dedicated-1  It has per-shard CPU, pool_util_pct, and the autoscale decision chart (bottom-right). Key metrics to watch: pool_util_pct, kv_cache_miss_rate, steal_queue_length, per_shard_cpu. :eyes:

jess: thx — which panel shows 'steal queue' historically? can't find it.

mike: it's under "Queues > steal_queue_length (1m)". direct link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/pools/eu-dedicated-1?panelId=42
for a quick PromQL check run:
```
max_over_time(steal_queue_length{pool=\"eu-dedicated-1\"}[1h])
```

ara: also look at KV cache evictions — when kv miss spikes, latency/reqs per GPU go up. my go-to query:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total{pool=\"eu-dedicated-1\"}[5m])) by (instance)
```

sasha: if you're tuning alerts, consider making them resistant to short bursts. we had noisy fires last week. suggested alert rule:
```
alert: PoolSaturationHigh
expr: avg_over_time(pool_util_pct{pool=\"eu-dedicated-1\"}[10m]) > 85
for: 10m
```

jess: good call. can someone drop the grafana + trace links into TKT-4452? opened the ticket for this tuning.

mike: done — linked dashboard + a trace showing KV-miss -> autoscaler decision: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/8f7b2a  pinned in the ticket. :mag:

ops-bot: Probe alert: eu-dedicated-1 autoscaler failed to scale at 2026-03-15T14:22:11Z — incident logged: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-291

jess: saw that — is that why scale didn't kick? @mike

mike: likely. logs show scaling RPC timeout to cluster-manager. see trace + logs: https://elk.redwood.ai/logs?query=rpc_timeout+eu-dedicated-1  I'm opening a small PR to increase autoscale RPC retries (3 -> 5) as a short-term mitigation.

ara: pinging @sasha for the alert retune approval. if we change retries, we can relax alert sensitivity afterwards.

sasha: approve the retune. one constraint: if we suppress noisy alerts, keep 7d of high-res metrics so we can validate. rollback plan required.

jess: perfect — I'll update TKT-4452 with the plan and set a 72h post-deploy check to re-evaluate. thanks all :thumbsup:
